card.name: Leukemia gene and mutation names
card.fires_on: The last piece of leukemia genetic marker names such as BCR::ABL1, T315I and FLT3, and linking words after leukemia type names (CML, AML) in oncology labels.

modes.label: Gene marker endings
modes.description: Final character or slash inside a fusion gene or mutation name like BCR::ABL1, T315I, FLT3.
modes.example: Dosage for patients with Ph+ CML-CP with the T315<<I>> mutation First 40 mg once daily

modes.label: Linking word after leukemia type
modes.description: The word 'with' following a leukemia type, introducing a subgroup or condition.
modes.example: 5.5 Use in AML<< with>> Adverse-Risk Cytogenetics

card.plain: It fires at the end of leukemia gene and mutation names, like BCR-ABL1 or FLT3, in cancer drug labels.
